subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should the final rebased stack adopt the Matrix dependency ownership move, shared QA prepareFlow seam, and Gateway channel-start admission change together in this migration PR?
rationale: The implementation is proven, but the final merge intentionally crosses plugin API, dependency, and process-lifecycle ownership boundaries that require explicit maintainer acceptance on the actual merge-ready SHA.

options.title: Rebase, authorize, and land
options.body: Resolve the dirty merge, review the final cross-owner seams, authorize dependencies for that SHA, and rerun exact-head proof before merging.

options.title: Split the shared lifecycle changes
options.body: Move the SDK or Gateway lifecycle changes into separately reviewed prerequisites if their ownership review cannot be completed within this stack PR.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Keep this and its successor open until maintainers agree on a narrower Matrix-to-QA-Lab migration boundary.

recommendation.title: Rebase, authorize, and land
recommendation.body: Resolve the dirty merge, review the final cross-owner seams, authorize dependencies for that SHA, and rerun exact-head proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the merged prerequisite and current migration stack and are best positioned to prepare the exact rebased result for cross-owner approval.
